🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, market labeled NEUTRAL per input. Confirmations: strong sector breadth (10/11) plus neutral risk ratios—VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY and SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION show mixed risk signals while Technology (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND) is the lone major laggard.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear neutral—VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY indicates limited panic. Credit flat—HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND keep HYG/LQD NEUTRAL; precious metals showing selective hedging with GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Yields ↑ as TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND is under pressure. Dollar direction NEUTRAL per macro ratios and credit spreads remain flat, so overall financial conditions = neutral.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and value showing leadership: Industrials (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +3.25%) and XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND with XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US broad market in CORRECTION—SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION—while China leading on the month: FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND and EM mixed with EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Crypto and thematic bifurcation: ETHA (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION show ongoing risk-on pockets, while ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND signals select de-risking.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity upside with CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND; gold and silver also ABOVE TREND—GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) and SLV (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +1.09%). Several energy and ag names show 1W/1M divergence (BNO, UGA, WEAT) indicating profit-taking tempo.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy overall positive: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND while oil proxies BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) in CORRECTION; gas weakness persists—UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: broad sector breadth and strength in XLE, XLF and CPER across timeframes. Divergence: Tech and key growth proxies—XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND—are material weak spots; overall this is a MINOR divergence relative to the broad 10/11 breadth.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity-linked exposures given breadth and CPER/XLE strength, and reduce exposure to clear tech laggards like XLK, QQQ and SOXX; bonds remain neutral with TLT BELOW TREND—monitor duration sensitivity.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND; Financials XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +3.25%) showing strength. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; Semis SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and diversified commodity PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND and short-term oil pullbacks in BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION to monitor.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health threshold), XLK/XLF spread (watch for tech vs value pivot), CPER 1W momentum continuation level.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with strong breadth: Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive and the data regime is NEUTRAL. Cyclicals and commodities showing relative strength—XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is persistent tech weakness—XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and semiconductors SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND—monitor for spillover.
